dct_description_sm: This map (and accompanying digitial CD-ROM) depict the distribution of different permafrost and periglacial landforms in the vicinity of the Clyde River townsite. Features were recorded from airphotographs and ground observations, and are displayed atop a high resolution satellite image. Mapped features include nivation hollows, thermokarst depressions, perennial snowpacks, gelifluction lobes, and ice wedges.
